hotel_name: Hotel Saffron Gold By F9 Hotels

positive_snippets: Quiet hotel. My experience was good. The best thing is 24 hrs of hot water cause I visited when it was 7° C. It does not have a centralized geyser so you can turn on and off the geyser at any time as it is separate for your washroom.

This hotel is good for its rate. It was clean, spacious and the hotel was polite enough to send us free tea.

However, it has a major mobile network connection issue usually there were no signals and even the wifi didn’t work properly.
negative_snippets:
Pleasant and comfortable stay. The property is as expected in this price range. The room (executive with balcony) and the attached bathroom were spacious . However had to get the room cleaned on check-in . Few important stuff like glasses and toiletries were missing and had to ask for them from the staff. Staff was polite and cooperative. Never said no to any supply that we asked for.
One major con is the smell of cigarette smoke emanating from the staircases and lobbies almost at all time in the afternoon and nights. Not sure who was responsible for it though, staff or customers. Also, balcony was not cleaned at all.
Overall a good experience for the price range.
Property is well done. But charged high as service is very bad and seems like the hotel is used as a one night picnic or visit Property by many youngsters or teenagers.
Location is not good they charge high according to the rooms and rooms were not clean properly and bed sheets towels were stinky badly.
